STAT_HORIZONTAL_DELTA_HEADING_WERT : Horizontal heading changes measured by the gyro
STAT_GYRO_TYPE : Type of gyro that is present in the car as integer
STAT_GYRO_TYPE_TEXT : Type of gyro that is present in the car value from table TGyroType
